_meta.description: New Iterable Handlebars patterns added in 2026. Supplement to schema/common-patterns.json.
_meta.feature_flag_note: All groupBy and sortBy patterns require the HandlebarsArrayHelpers feature flag to be enabled for the project.

groupby_with_catalog_display.name: groupBy with catalogCollection — Full Product Display
groupby_with_catalog_display.use_case: Fetch catalog items and display them grouped by category with full product details (image, name, description, price)
requirements: HandlebarsArrayHelpers feature flag must be enabled for this project
Set ALL catalog field mappings BEFORE loading items
dataFields fields are accessed directly: product.category, not product.dataFields.category

sortby_price_ascending.name: sortBy — Sort Catalog Items by Price
sortby_price_ascending.use_case: Fetch catalog items and display sorted by price ascending (lowest first)
notes: sortBy GA June 5 2026 — requires HandlebarsArrayHelpers feature flag
Type (number/string/date) auto-detected from first non-null value — no type param needed
Nulls always sort last regardless of asc/desc

sort_then_group.name: sortBy → groupBy — Control Group Insertion Order
sort_then_group.use_case: Pre-sort array so that groups appear in desired order. groupBy preserves first-seen key order, so sorting first controls group sequence.
sort_then_group.why: groupBy preserves insertion order of the first time a key is encountered. If you want groups sorted (e.g. chronologically by date), sort the input array first.

group_then_sort_within.name: groupBy → sortBy within each group
group_then_sort_within.use_case: Group items by shipping method, then sort items within each group by price ascending

sort_group_sort_composition.name: Full sortBy → groupBy → sortBy Composition
sort_group_sort_composition.use_case: Pre-sort by date for group order, group by method+date, inner-sort by price desc within each group

rei_order_confirmation.name: REI-Style Order Confirmation — Deep Nested Event Data
rei_order_confirmation.use_case: Display order line items from nested event payload. Group by shipping method + promised delivery date, sorted chronologically. Inner-sort by price descending.
key_notes: Pre-sorting by ItemFirstPromisedDate forces shipment groups into chronological order
Key paths use FULL dot notation: group.key.LineItems.ItemShippingMethod (not group.key.ItemShippingMethod)
Multi-field group key: field="a,b" creates composite key accessed as group.key.a and group.key.b
Inner sort puts highest-value item at top of each shipment group

named_block_params_at_index_fix.name: @index / @last inside groupBy Items — Named Block Params Workaround
named_block_params_at_index_fix.problem: @index, @first, @last inside {{#each group.items}} reflect the outer groups loop index, not the inner items loop. This is a Java Handlebars scoping behavior.
named_block_params_at_index_fix.why_wrong: @index and @last here reflect the position in the groups array, not the position within group.items
named_block_params_at_index_fix.explanation: Using named block params (item iIdx) gives you a correctly-scoped index for the inner each loop.
named_block_params_at_index_fix.also_applies_to: Any nested {{#each}} inside a block helper. Named block params always give the correct scoped index.

empty_state_handling.name: groupBy Empty State Handling
empty_state_handling.use_case: Handle the case where the input array is empty or groupBy produces no groups
empty_state_handling.note: When the input array is empty, groupBy renders the block with an empty groups array. Use {{#if groups}} to detect and handle the empty state.

multi_field_sort_tiebreaker.name: sortBy Multi-Field Tiebreaker Sort
multi_field_sort_tiebreaker.use_case: Sort by primary field, use secondary field to break ties
notes: First field (priority) is primary sort key
Second field (name) breaks ties when priority values are equal
Both fields use the same order= direction
For mixed directions, chain two sortBy calls (inner sort first, outer sort second)
